error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not connect to monitoring.tecel.ru on port 443. Check network access from the Home Assistant host or container.
error.connection_dns: Home Assistant could not resolve the TECEL server address. Check DNS from the Home Assistant host or container.
error.connection_tls: Home Assistant could not establish a secure connection to TECEL. Check the system clock and trusted certificates.
error.connection_proxy: Home Assistant could not reach its configured proxy for TECEL. Check the proxy settings.
error.connection_timeout: The request to TECEL timed out. Check connectivity from Home Assistant and try again.
error.passport_response: TECEL Passport returned an unexpected response. See the Prizrak entry in the Home Assistant logs.
error.passport_action_required: TECEL Passport requires an action on your account. Sign in to monitoring.tecel.ru for details.
error.passport_version: TECEL Passport rejected the client version. Try again to fetch the current version.
error.rate_limited: TECEL is temporarily limiting sign-in requests. Wait before trying again.
